notes: No candidate was cloned, built or analyzed. gh api reads only.

Needs mix: Postgres expected for 10/10; Redis or worker expected for 7/10 (discourse, forem, saleor, eshop, cachet, trigger-dev; ente/hexpm/dependency-track/mathesar are Postgres plus storage or none). Runtimes: Ruby x2, Python x2, Elixir, .NET, Go, Java, PHP, Node/TS.
Risk discourse: no Dockerfile in repo (images come from the separate discourse_docker launcher); Rails with Sidekiq, Redis, and many plugins. Label deploy mode carefully.
Risk forem: very heavy Rails app, Elasticsearch-free now but needs Sidekiq, Redis, Postgres, many third-party keys; Dockerfile and Containerfile both present.
Risk saleor: Dockerfile builds API only; Celery worker uses same image with different command; Postgres extensions needed.
Risk hexpm: no SPDX license in GitHub metadata (license null); Elixir release; needs S3-like storage and other services; labels depend on config/runtime.exs.
Risk eshop: no Dockerfile at root; Aspire AppHost orchestrates many services (Postgres, Redis, RabbitMQ), so labeling must treat it as multi-service. CI shows 1 failure (informational).
Risk ente: monorepo; only server/ is deployable; renamed from ente-io/ente to ente/ente; needs Postgres and S3 (MinIO in compose). Selected path is subdirectory.
Risk dependency-track: monorepo in v5 modular layout; Dockerfile under apiserver/src/main/docker may expect prebuilt artifacts from Maven; frontend is a separate repo.
Risk cachet: default branch is 3.x (not main); no Dockerfile; license NOASSERTION; CI shows failure=3 (informational); small Laravel app.
Risk trigger-dev: large Turborepo monorepo; docker/Dockerfile is for the webapp; separate supervisor app for workers; CI failure=1 (informational).
Risk mathesar: it connects to a user Postgres database and also keeps its own metadata DB; Dockerfile plus Caddy; develop is the default branch.
Rejected during screening: AppFlowy-IO/AppFlowy-Cloud (archived); medusajs/medusa (library monorepo without a single app entry point).
